belief: “My future holds only more pain. I will never feel safe or whole again.”
belief_plain: My future holds only more pain. I will never feel safe or whole again
origins: When pain has lasted, the mind protects itself by expecting more of the same. “If I do not hope, I cannot be disappointed.” That can feel like realism. It is a closed future: only more pain, never safe, never whole. You do not have to pretend the past was small. You also do not have to sign away every year ahead. A counselor can help you hold both the wound and a future that is not only the wound. A counselor can help you work with this at a pace that is safe. You do not have to do it alone, or all at once. If you are thinking about ending your life, call or text 988 in the United States, or tell someone near you right away.
self: The rest of my life will feel like this.
I will never feel safe or whole, so I should stop wanting that.
Good things are for people who were not hurt.
If God loved me, the future would already look different.
replacement: My future is not only more pain. God is with me, His mercy is new, and wholeness can grow even while I still hurt.
